activity_summary: The first rehearsal on the big stage was the comedy for Easter Monday. The yard was three times the Cross Keys. Garnish had a new plot by the stage door. Cowley missed Dull's entrance three times because the cue was a Latin tag he could not hear from behind the arras. Nick was sound and did not shout. Arthur's hooks had split and were left. You said you would take the roll home. No bill was up. Larkham was in the yard and did not speak.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the fault as his own and took the roll home in promise.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Demanded the length of the boards for Berowne.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Missed the entrance three times and asked for a hearable word.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Called an unheard tag a private joke, and said the house was not open.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Arrived as the Princess without swelling the voice.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Showed the split hooks and did not get a hem written.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Hung the new plot, and refused to prompt from two truths.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Heard. He was not asked to copy.

entities.name: the comedy
entities.context: Mentioned in Three times the yard
